name: Loop Now 官方插件市场

description.zh-CN: 让项目里的 Agent 在 Cloudflare 上开发：官方 Skills、Cloudflare API 的 MCP 服务器，以及给 cf 与 Wrangler 用的 API 令牌。令牌按项目添加、按 Agent 授权。
description.en-US: Build on Cloudflare from project Agents: the official Skills, the Cloudflare API MCP server, and an API token for the cf and Wrangler CLIs, added per project and granted per Agent.

description.zh-CN: 让 Agent 通过本机 Figma 桌面版的官方 MCP 读取设计稿：结构、截图、变量和 Code Connect。需要桌面版开启 desktop MCP server。
description.en-US: Give agents Figma's official desktop MCP server: design context, screenshots, variables and Code Connect from the Figma desktop app running on this machine.

description.zh-CN: 让 Agent 通过 Open Design 桌面版的 MCP 服务器生成和修改设计稿、网页原型、演示稿与图片，并读取项目文件。生成用 Open Design 自己的运行时。
description.en-US: Let Agents have the Open Design desktop app generate and refine designs, web prototypes, decks and images through its MCP server, and read project files. Generation runs on Open Design's own runtime.

description.zh-CN: 社区 Pi 扩展 pi-grok-cli：用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 订阅登录，让 Agent 使用 Grok 模型。非 xAI 官方；订阅账号按项目登录、按 Agent 选择。
description.en-US: Community Pi extension pi-grok-cli: run Agents on Grok models with a SuperGrok or X Premium subscription. Not an official xAI integration. Accounts are added per project and chosen per Agent.

description.zh-CN: 在 Slack 频道或私信里和项目 Manager 对话；代管一个外部身份，让 Agent 的消息和提问到 Slack 里找人。Socket Mode，不需要公网地址。
description.en-US: Talk to a project's Manager from Slack channels or DMs; let a plugin-managed external identity bring agents' messages and questions to people on Slack. Socket Mode, no public URL needed.

description.zh-CN: 让项目里的 Agent 管理 Supabase：官方 Skills、Supabase 的 MCP 服务器，以及给 supabase 命令行用的访问令牌。可以只限一个项目、只读运行；令牌按项目添加、按 Agent 授权。
description.en-US: Work with Supabase from project Agents: official Skills, the Supabase MCP server, and a token for the supabase CLI, added per project and granted per Agent. Can be scoped to one project and read-only.
